text:
nina: quick thread  proposal: add a tiny .fastopen sidecar per shard that lists window-granularity, window-count, and either an index_hash or per-window MACs. goal: enable safe streaming warmup without forcing full manifest fetch.

anya: sounds promising. sidecar keeps safetensors on-disk invariant which is key for mmap loaders. can server advertise the sidecar URL via an HTTP header?

mike: yes, X-Weight-FastOpen -> URL or base64 header. two immediate tradeoffs: 1) header size vs sidecar fetch, 2) CPU cost for client-side MAC checks.

sam: operational model: client fetches sidecar in parallel with streaming weights. if sidecar only has index_hash, we mark warmup entries provisional and verify later. need a provisional flag in KV API.

nina: proposal: provisional entries are marked "provisional:true" and runtime will not serve them for safety-critical requests. promote to verified when signature + index match. on mismatch, tombstone/unpin provisional windows and optionally fall back to cached model or variant.

anya: add signature field in sidecar: root_sig so clients can trust without manifest. signer must be artifact-signer v2. also include a small root_hash.

mike: consider defaults: 1MB windows (configurable). avoid tiny windows that blow up MAC overhead. server can return a hint header X-Weight-VerifyMode: fast|strict.

warmup-bot: scheduled canary: eng-ml/warmup-experiments @ 03:15 UTC for fastopen-sidecar.

sam: metrics we should capture: provisional_promote_latency, provisional_eviction_rate, provisional_hit_ratio, client-verify-cpu-ms. helps choose granularity.

nina: example sidecar (minified): {"v":"1","granularity":1048576,"windows":[{"off":0,"len":1048576,"mac":"ab12..."}],"root_hash":"sha256:...","root_sig":"sig-v2:..."}

anya: please include a couple regression tests for mmap loader offsets and CDN byte-range behavior. I'll draft a short RFC and link tests.

mike: +1. also add an opt-out server header for fleets that don't want client verification CPU overhead.

nina: thanks all, will open RFC and attach canary. :rocket:
